narrative: Tehran's weekend declaration that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed anchors safe-haven USD demand and supply-shock risks for the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1490; widening policy divergence and a +141bp SOFR-€STR carry advantage favor the greenback, leaving the pair vulnerable ahead of ECB President Lagarde's Monday addresses. USD/JPY closed Friday at 156.85; lingering disappointment over the BoJ's divided hike to 1.25% leaves JPY defensive against broad USD strength at the open.
